title: Best Ivation Dehumidifier (2026): Pump, 70-Pint & Desiccant
h1: The Best Ivation Dehumidifiers — and the Recall to Check First
dek: Ivation makes both compressor and cold-weather desiccant units. One of its current model numbers sits a single letter away from a recalled one.
description: The best Ivation dehumidifier for your space: the 50-pint pump model, 70-pint, Wi-Fi and 13-pint desiccant, plus the 2021 recall and manual help.
intro: An Ivation dehumidifier is a slightly unusual choice in a market full of near-identical white boxes. The brand sells two different technologies: conventional compressor units in 50- and 70-pint sizes, and **desiccant** models that keep drying in cold spaces where a compressor would freeze. Our top pick is the **IVADH50PWP2**, a 50-pint unit with a built-in pump.

There's one thing to check before you buy secondhand or dust off an older unit. In 2021, two Ivation models — the 30-pint **IVADH30PW** and 70-pint **IVADH70PW**, made before September 1, 2017 — were part of a major CPSC fire-hazard recall. Ivation's current 70-pint is the **IVALDH70PW**: the same string with one extra letter. It isn't recalled, but it's an easy name to mix up.
We compared the current lineup using Ivation's spec sheets and manuals, ENERGY STAR listings, the CPSC recall notice and owner reviews. Here's what to buy and how to make sure an older unit is safe.
topPicksLead: The **Ivation IVADH50PWP2** is our top pick: 50 pints a day, ENERGY STAR certification and a built-in pump for basements without a floor drain.

products.name: Ivation 50-Pint Dehumidifier with Pump (IVADH50PWP2)
pros: Built-in condensate pump with hose connector

products.whyWeLoveIt: A built-in pump is the feature that makes a basement dehumidifier truly hands-off, and this Ivation includes one alongside ENERGY STAR efficiency. Set a target, run the hose to a sink or window and let it work.
products.performance: It's rated at 50 pints a day and pairs a programmable humidistat with both pump and gravity drainage options. Owners highlight the pump as the main reason they chose it, especially in basements where the floor drain is in the wrong place. The "P2" suffix marks it as a current product line distinct from the recalled IVADH30PW and IVADH70PW. Compare it with other brands in our [best dehumidifier with pump](/best/best-dehumidifier-with-pump/) guide.

products.name: Ivation 70-Pint Dehumidifier (IVALDH70PW)
pros: 70 pints a day for big or very damp rooms
Large reservoir means less frequent emptying
Built-in casters for moving between spaces

products.whyWeLoveIt: For a large basement or open lower level, the IVALDH70PW brings more capacity and a bigger reservoir than the 50-pint models, and it rolls easily on casters when you need to move it.
products.performance: Ivation rates it at 70 pints a day with a large-capacity reservoir, so in a damp space you'll empty it less often than a typical 50-pint bucket. Without a pump, plan on a gravity hose to a floor drain or manual emptying. It's not part of the 2021 recall — that was the **IVADH70PW**, without the "L". See how it compares with other high-capacity units in our [best 70-pint dehumidifier](/best/best-70-pint-dehumidifier/) guide.
products.notes: If you already own an Ivation 70-pint, read the model label carefully and check it against CPSC.gov before assuming either way.

products.name: Ivation 13-Pint Small-Area Desiccant Dehumidifier
pros: Lighter and quieter than compressor units
cons: Uses more energy per pint in warm rooms
products.whyWeLoveIt: When a garage, cellar or RV sits in the 30s and 40s, compressor dehumidifiers ice over and stop. This desiccant unit uses a moisture-absorbing rotor instead, so it keeps drying close to freezing.
products.performance: Ivation rates it at 13 pints a day at 68°F and 60% humidity, covering spaces up to about 270 sq ft. That's modest capacity, but its real strength is cold-weather performance, where it outlasts compressor units entirely. A larger 19-pint sibling is available for bigger cold spaces. Learn more in our [best desiccant dehumidifier](/best/best-desiccant-dehumidifier/) guide.

sections.heading: How we pick the best Ivation dehumidifiers

blocks.text: We don't lab-test. We compared Ivation's spec sheets and manuals with ENERGY STAR listings, checked every current and recent model number against the CPSC recall database, and read owner reviews for recurring issues like pump failures and sensor drift. Because of Ivation's recall history, we gave extra attention to model-number clarity and to how easy it is for an owner to confirm a unit is safe.

sections.heading: What to look for in an Ivation dehumidifier

items.label: Compressor or desiccant
items.text: Above about 41°F, a compressor unit removes more water for less energy. Colder than that, choose desiccant. Our [how a dehumidifier works](/guides/how-does-a-dehumidifier-work/) explainer covers the difference.

items.label: A pump if you need one
items.text: The IVADH50PWP2 and IVADUWIFI50WP pump water up and out; the IVALDH70PW relies on gravity or emptying.

items.label: The right capacity
items.text: 50 pints suits most basements; 70 pints for very large or wet spaces. See our [size guide](/guides/dehumidifier-size-guide/).

items.label: The exact model number
items.text: Read the label letter by letter, especially on any 30- or 70-pint Ivation, and check it against CPSC.gov.

items.label: Wi-Fi only if useful
items.text: The smart model costs a little more; it earns its keep in a basement you rarely enter.

blocks.text: In August 2021, the CPSC announced a recall of about **2 million dehumidifiers** sold under 20 brand names, all made by New Widetech before September 1, 2017. The units could overheat and catch fire; the manufacturer reported 107 incidents and roughly $17 million in property damage across all brands. They were sold at major retailers from February 2009 through August 2017.

blocks.title: If you own an older Ivation
blocks.text: Find the model and serial number on the unit's label and check them against the recall notice on CPSC.gov. If it matches, stop using it, unplug it and follow the notice's instructions for a refund. Don't rely on memory — one letter changes the answer. Disposing of an old unit? See [how to dispose of a dehumidifier](/guides/how-to-dispose-of-a-dehumidifier/).

sections.heading: Ivation dehumidifier manual and common fixes

blocks.text: Ivation posts user manuals on its website by model number; the label on the back of the unit has what you need. A few problems come up again and again in owner reviews:

items: **Full-tank light with an empty tank:** reseat the bucket so the float switch can move freely.
**Pump not draining:** check the hose for kinks and make sure it's within the rated lift height.
**Little or no water:** the room may be dry already, or a compressor unit may be icing in a cool space. See our [not collecting water](/guides/dehumidifier-not-collecting-water/) guide.
**Dusty or musty air:** wash the filter every few weeks during heavy use.

blocks.text: The **Ivation IVADH50PWP2** is the best Ivation dehumidifier for most basements thanks to its built-in pump and ENERGY STAR rating. Step up to the **IVALDH70PW** for bigger spaces, choose the **IVADUWIFI50WP** for app control, and pick the **13-Pint Desiccant** for cold garages, cellars and RVs. And if you have an older Ivation, check its exact model and serial number against the 2021 recall. For how Ivation compares with other brands, see our [best dehumidifier brands](/best/best-dehumidifier-brands/) guide.

faqs.q: What is the best Ivation dehumidifier?
faqs.a: For most basements, the IVADH50PWP2, a 50-pint ENERGY STAR unit with a built-in pump. For larger spaces, the 70-pint IVALDH70PW; for app control, the IVADUWIFI50WP; and for cold spaces, the 13-pint desiccant model.

faqs.q: What is the Ivation IVADM35 dehumidifier?
faqs.a: The IVADM35 is a mid-size model that appears in Ivation's range alongside the 50- and 70-pint units. If you're considering it, compare its DOE pint rating and coverage on the spec sheet against your space, and confirm the listing is new stock with a full warranty.

faqs.q: Where can I find my Ivation dehumidifier manual?
faqs.a: Ivation posts manuals on its website, searchable by model number. The model number is printed on the label on the back or side of the unit.

faqs.q: Does Ivation make a dehumidifier for cold spaces?
faqs.a: Yes. Its 13-pint and 19-pint desiccant models use a moisture-absorbing rotor rather than a cold coil, so they keep working down to about 33°F, where compressor units ice over.
